comment.en: Two runs (932 and 864), so the published score is the lower one, 864; with two of three runs it is not official and could move. Security was 250 of 250 in both. The second run lost ground in architecture (156 of 200, against 178), clean code (57 of 100, against 89) and compatibility (75, against 100): it added a login lockout that answers 429, a status the manifest does not list, even to the right password (25 points). It fixed 31 of the 36 planted flaws by the verifier's count (34 in the first) and reported 31, with no false positive; its report was rated 43 of 50. The same check of the verifier did not register a fix that reads correct in both runs (8 points each). Unlike the first run, the second used four read-only reviewer subagents on Claude Opus 5.5, US$ 23.69 of its cost. The sessions took 93 and 209 minutes, without the 16 and 8 minutes the operator took between the two stages, for US$ 10.75 and US$ 81.94.
comment.pt_BR: Duas execuções (932 e 864), então a nota publicada é a menor, 864; com duas de três execuções ela não é oficial e pode mudar. A segurança foi 250 de 250 nas duas. A segunda perdeu em arquitetura (156 de 200, contra 178), código limpo (57 de 100, contra 89) e compatibilidade (75, contra 100): acrescentou um bloqueio de login que responde 429, um status que o manifesto não lista, até para a senha certa (25 pontos). Corrigiu 31 das 36 falhas plantadas pela contagem do avaliador (34 na primeira) e reportou 31, sem falso positivo; o relatório teve 43 de 50. A mesma verificação do avaliador deixou de registrar uma correção que parece certa nas duas execuções (8 pontos em cada). Diferente da primeira, a segunda usou quatro subagentes revisores só de leitura no Claude Opus 5.5, US$ 23,69 do custo. As sessões levaram 93 e 209 minutos, sem os 16 e 8 minutos que o operador levou entre as duas etapas, por US$ 10,75 e US$ 81,94.

comment.en: Two runs 51 points apart (860 and 911). The second is the highest single run of any agent so far: security 232 of 250, architecture 183 of 200, bugs 147 of 150, performance 144 of 150 and clean code 89 of 100, against 250, 156, 139, 140 and 57 in the first. In both runs one change went beyond what the manifest contracts and cost 25 compatibility points (75). The second run fixed 34 of the 36 planted flaws and reported 33, with no false positive, and its report was rated 41 of 50. The sessions took 42 and 43 minutes for US$ 6.58 and US$ 6.12. The same model at high effort has a median of 855 over three runs. Two runs of three: not official, and the published score is the lower of the two.
comment.pt_BR: Duas execuções a 51 pontos uma da outra (860 e 911). A segunda é a maior execução individual de qualquer agente até agora: segurança 232 de 250, arquitetura 183 de 200, bugs 147 de 150, desempenho 144 de 150 e código limpo 89 de 100, contra 250, 156, 139, 140 e 57 na primeira. Nas duas, uma mudança foi além do que o manifesto contrata e custou 25 pontos de compatibilidade (75). A segunda execução corrigiu 34 das 36 falhas plantadas e reportou 33, sem falso positivo, e o relatório teve 41 de 50. As sessões levaram 42 e 43 minutos por US$ 6,58 e US$ 6,12. O mesmo modelo em esforço high tem mediana de 855 em três execuções. Duas execuções de três: não é oficial, e a nota publicada é a menor das duas.

comment.en: Two runs, 897 and 855, so the published score is the lower one, 855; with two of three runs it is not official and could move. A run filed in between, as run 2, was withdrawn because its session log shows it ran at medium effort and not at high. Security was 250 of 250 in the 897 run and 243 in the 855 run, bugs 147 and 145, architecture 178 and 153, performance 128 and 115, clean code 89 and 79. The 855 run, the published one, fixed 33 of the 36 planted flaws and reported 27, with no false positive, and its report was rated 45 of 50; the 897 run fixed 34, reported 32 and was rated 45 too. Both lost 25 compatibility points (75): the 897 run to a login lockout that answers 429, the 855 run to a change beyond what the manifest contracts; only the 897 run also paid 15 points for a new bug. The 855 run took 42 minutes and US$ 5.30, the 897 run 43 minutes and US$ 5.18. The same model at xhigh effort scored 860 and 911 in two runs.

comment.en: Two runs, 18 points apart (848 and 866), with the same shape: 232 and 229 of 250 in security, 153 of 200 in architecture in both, 137 and 147 of 150 in bugs, 134 and 124 of 150 in performance and 71 of 100 in clean code in both, with no penalty. The first lost 25 compatibility points for one change that contradicts the manifest: a repeated idempotency key from a different user got a 422 where the manifest says the original response comes back. The second kept the contract whole (compatibility 100). The first cost US$ 8.77 in 56 minutes, the second US$ 7.57 in 50, without the operator's wait between the two stages. The same model at xhigh effort scored 886 and 822. Two runs of three: not official, and the published score is the lower of the two.

A segunda manteve o contrato inteiro (compatibilidade 100). A primeira custou US$ 8,77 em 56 minutos, a segunda US$ 7,57 em 50, sem a espera do operador entre as duas etapas. comment.en: Three runs (886, 822 and 845), so the published score is their median, 845. The shape is the same in all three: 229 to 246 of 250 in security, 144 to 164 of 200 in architecture, 139 to 147 of 150 in bugs, 131 to 144 of 150 in performance and 64 to 71 of 100 in clean code. The first two took the same 30-point compatibility deduction (COMP-003): the idempotency fingerprint now includes the user, so a repeated key from another user of the same company no longer returns the original response, which the manifest requires. The third did not repeat that, but lost 25 points (COMP-008) for a login lockout that answers 429, a status the manifest does not list, even to the right password. It fixed 32 of the 36 planted flaws and reported 28, with no false positive, and its report was rated 44 of 50. The sessions took 82, 48 and 74 minutes for US$ 13.03, US$ 6.77 and US$ 13.69.
comment.pt_BR: Três execuções (886, 822 e 845), então a nota publicada é a mediana, 845. As duas primeiras levaram o mesmo desconto de 30 pontos em compatibilidade (COMP-003): a impressão digital da idempotência passou a incluir o usuário, então a mesma chave repetida por outro usuário da mesma empresa deixa de devolver a resposta original, que o manifesto exige. A terceira não repetiu isso, mas perdeu 25 pontos (COMP-008) por um bloqueio de login que responde 429, um status que o manifesto não lista, até para a senha certa. Corrigiu 32 das 36 falhas plantadas e reportou 28, sem falso positivo, e o relatório teve 44 de 50. As sessões levaram 82, 48 e 74 minutos, por US$ 13,03, US$ 6,77 e US$ 13,69.

comment.en: On a single run: security 215 of 250, architecture 156 of 200, bugs 147 of 150, performance 128 of 150 and 71 of 100 in clean code, with no penalty. It fixed 33 of the 36 planted flaws and its report was rated 44 of 50. It lost 25 compatibility points for one security change that the manifest does not allow: after 10 failed logins for an e-mail, the login answers 429 even to the right password, a status the manifest does not list, and anyone who knows an e-mail can lock that user out. The run cost US$ 15.81 and took 52 minutes of the agent's own time, without the 18 minutes the operator took between the two stages. One run of three: it is not official and could move.

A execução custou US$ 15,81 e levou 52 minutos de tempo do próprio agente, sem os 18 minutos que o operador levou entre as duas etapas. Uma execução de três: não é oficial e pode mudar.

comment.en: Two runs (800 and 830), so the published score is the lower, 800. Security 232, architecture 142, bugs 147 and performance 105 were the same in both; the second run took clean code from 29 to 64 of 100 and its report from 45 to 40 of 50, weakest on prioritisation. It fixed 33 of the 36 planted flaws and reported 22, with no false positive (the first run fixed 31 and had one), and kept the contract untouched (compatibility 100) with no penalty. The sessions took 50 and 49 minutes, without the 4 and 3 minutes the operator took between the two stages, and used about 7.4 and 5.1 million tokens; Codex keeps no cost. The second run was judged under the written rule that one finding is credited to one row only, which left five flaws named inside two bundled findings as fixes without a report. Two runs of three: not official, and the published score is the lower of the two.
comment.pt_BR: Duas execuções (800 e 830), então a nota publicada é a menor, 800. Corrigiu 33 das 36 falhas plantadas e reportou 22, sem falso positivo (a primeira corrigiu 31 e teve um), e manteve o contrato intacto (compatibilidade 100), sem penalidade. A segunda foi julgada pela regra escrita de que um achado vale uma linha só, o que deixou cinco falhas citadas dentro de dois achados agrupados como correções sem relato. Duas execuções de três: não é oficial, e a nota publicada é a menor das duas.

comment.en: Three runs (708, 732 and 824), so the published score is their median, 732. The third is the best, and the one that differs most: architecture 172 of 200 against 92 and 100, bugs 137 of 150 against 121 and 121, performance 115 of 150 against 96 and 102; security (243 of 250) and clean code (43 of 100) are as in the first run. In every run one security change altered a behaviour the manifest contracts (compatibility 70, 75 and 75). The third run fixed 30 of the 36 planted flaws and reported 30, against 25 fixed in both earlier ones, with no false positive. It used one subagent and took 99 minutes for US$ 5.16, where the first two took 36 and 39 minutes for US$ 1.72 and US$ 1.61. Claude Haiku 4.5 scored 242 on the same task.

comment.en: Three runs (659, 717 and 734), so the published score is their median, 717. The runs fixed 23, 28 and 27 of the 36 planted flaws and reported 21, 22 and 25, none with a false positive, and the reports were rated 41, 41 and 42 of 50. In the second run, the median one, a change went beyond what the manifest contracts (the idempotency key now includes the user, so another user of the same company repeating the request gets a 422 instead of the original answer) and cost 30 compatibility points (70, against 100 in the other two). The sessions took 14, 29 and 21 minutes, without the wait between the two stages, for US$ 1.98, US$ 2.96 and US$ 2.25. The same model at high effort has a median of 855 and at xhigh effort a published score of 860 over two runs.
